# Fathom CPG

> Fathom CPG is the fractional analytics and storytelling partner for founder-led CPG (consumer packaged goods) brands. Founded by Madison Marsh, based in Chicago, Illinois.

Fathom CPG works with founder-led food, beverage, and consumer brands from $0 to $50M in revenue, past launch and already in real retail. Madison Marsh brings hands-on retail analytics experience (syndicated data, trade planning, category management, retailer decks, consumer research, and dashboards) as a fractional, one-person alternative to hiring a full-time analytics team. Engagements run as one-time projects or month-to-month retainers, with no long-term lock-in.

- [Success Stories](https://fathomcpg.com/stories/): Client case studies (site is new; stories are added as engagements complete).
- [Methodology](https://fathomcpg.com/method/): How Fathom CPG approaches an engagement, step by step.
- [Partner With Me](https://fathomcpg.com/partner/): Intake form to start a conversation about working together.
